The '''Antares system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was also the home to a [[Antarean butterfly/Legends|type]] of [[Butterfly/Legends|butterfly]] that was equipped with a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] stinger.
